doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Additional Acquisition of Consolidated Subsidiary Shares (Complete Subsidiary Status)
doc_title_jp: 連結子会社株式の追加取得（完全子会社化）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 事業環境の変化に迅速かつ的確に対応し、グループ内連携及び経営基盤の強化を図るため

summary_en: Board resolution to acquire additional 30% stake (60,000 shares) in consolidated subsidiary GBS (Singapore) PTE. LTD. to achieve 100% ownership. Parent company Japan Material to acquire 42,000 shares; subsidiary ALDON TECHNOLOGIES SERVICES PTE LTD to acquire 18,000 shares. Execution scheduled 2026-07-30. Rationale: strengthen group coordination and management foundation in response to business environment changes.
summary_jp: 連結子会社GBS（SINGAPORE）PTE. LTD.の追加30%取得（60,000株）により完全子会社化を決議。親会社42,000株、ALDON子会社18,000株を取得。実行予定日2026年7月30日。事業環境変化への対応とグループ連携強化が理由。
